description: This file contains test functions for the hosted VLLM passthrough functionality in the litellm project. It utilizes pytest and asyncio to test the behavior of the passthrough route and configuration retrieval with mocked HTTP client responses.

classes.name: AsyncHTTPHandler
classes.description: An asynchronous HTTP request handler used in testing to simulate network interactions.

methods.name: test_get_provider_passthrough_config_for_hosted_vllm_returns_vllm_config()
methods.description: Tests retrieval of passthrough config for hosted VLLM models, asserting it returns an instance of VLLMPassthroughConfig.

methods.name: test_allm_passthrough_route_with_hosted_vllm_model_does_not_raise()
methods.description: Asynchronous test that mocks network interactions to verify the passthrough route operates correctly with a hosted VLLM model, ensuring no exceptions are raised and a successful response is returned.
